title: Linux - User Information (formerly User Information)
html:
User Information

User identity, group membership, and delegated credentials determine which resources a process can reach. Check the effective identity and supplementary groups before investigating the access paths below.

  • Users, sessions, and credential artifacts covers account enumeration, active logins, SSH and shell artifacts, and credential stores.
  • Real, effective, and saved user IDs explains identity changes around SUID programs and process execution.
  • Interesting groups for Linux privilege escalation covers group-granted access, including LXD/LXC.
  • SSH forwarding agent exploitation examines risks from forwarded SSH credentials.
  • Linux Active Directory covers hosts joined to an AD environment.
